In Kansas, Reverend Adam Hamilton is running for Senate — as a Democrat. It’s a departure from the typical Democratic approach, and Vox’s Christian Paz traveled to Hamilton’s church in Kansas to talk to the reverend about why he thinks it could win back voters the left has lost in the past few years.
